**The geopolitical weaponization of shipping channels**

The rapid development of the shipping industry in recent years has made global trade more convenient, but it has also brought about various new challenges. The strategic weaponization of shipping channels is one of the important issues. Countries often use shipping channels as a strategic weapon to protect their economic and political interests. For example, some countries may restrict or close shipping channels to exert pressure on or impose economic sanctions on other countries. This practice can have a significant impact on global trade and the economy. At the same time, the strategic weaponization of shipping channels can also lead to various security problems. For example, shipping channels may be used as a route for smuggling or terrorism. Therefore, countries need to strengthen cooperation to ensure the safety and smoothness of shipping channels.
